title: Surviving Eratosthenes sieve I: quadratic density and Legendre's conjecture
summary: We have been studying Eratosthenes sieve as a discrete dynamic system, obtaining exact models for the relative populations for small gaps (currently gaps $g \le 82$) in the cycle of gaps ${\mathcal G}(p^\#)$ at each stage of the sieve. The gaps in the interval $ΔH(p_k)=[p_k^2, p_{k+1}^2]$ are fixed in ${\mathcal G}(p^\#)$ and survive all subsequent stages of the sieve to be confirmed as gaps between primes.
